say:1:1430234101:1.text: Prince Ravion places too much importance on the commoners, which is not good for us nobles.
say:1:1430234101:1.source_cn: 沙利叶殿下太重视那些平民了，这对于我们贵族来说并不是件好事。
say:1:1430234101:1.male: Prince Ravion places too much importance on the commoners, which is not good for us nobles.
say:1:1430234101:1.female: Prince Ravion places too much importance on the commoners, which is not good for us nobles.

say:2:1430234102:1.text: He may be the Queen's son, but he's not on the side of the nobility.
say:2:1430234102:1.source_cn: 虽然他是女王的亲子，但显然，他并不站在我们贵族这边。
say:2:1430234102:1.male: He may be the Queen's son, but he's not on the side of the nobility.
say:2:1430234102:1.female: He may be the Queen's son, but he's not on the side of the nobility.
